Subject: OpenRidge Access Controls — SSO/SCIM & service account handoff

Hi Evan —

Great to meet last week. Per our onboarding plan I wanted to kick off the access-controls workstream so we can get OpenRidge fully onboarded with SSO + SCIM provisioning and the account-level controls (IP allowlist, service accounts, org policies).

Proposed two-phase approach (high level):
- Phase 1 (this week): SSO (SAML) configuration and basic SP metadata validation; verify IdP attributes we need for SCIM and group mapping.
- Phase 2 (next week): SCIM provisioning setup, service account creation, IP allowlist applied to control-plane endpoints, and final org-policy checks.

Requesting the following from your side before the kickoff call:
1) SAML metadata or IdP SSO URL + certificate (we can accept raw metadata XML or a URL).
2) SCIM attribute list you currently populate (userName, emails, name.givenName, name.familyName, groups, externalId, title) — if you have a CSV we can ingest, please attach.
3) IP ranges for outbound management traffic and any static NATs for your firewalls (we will only enforce allowlist on the management/control-plane endpoints unless you request otherwise).
4) Names and intended permissions for any automated service accounts you want Redwood to provision.

Attached: openridge-sso-mapping.xlsx — a simple workbook to map IdP attributes to Redwood fields (please fill the right-hand column where you can). Also link to our onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/openridge/onboarding/checklist

We propose a 60-minute kickoff tomorrow (Fri 6/11) at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the mapping and confirm timeline. Is that OK?

Thanks — I’ll let Marissa and Monica coordinate the implementation schedule once we have the artifacts.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com]

Quick answers and attachments (attached files):
- SAML metadata: attaching idp-metadata.xml from our Okta tenant.
- SCIM attributes: attached scim-attributes.csv — this includes email, userName, givenName, familyName, title, manager, groups.
- IP list: attaching openridge-ip-allowlist.txt (these are the NATed egress ranges from our office + cloud peering).

About service accounts: we anticipate two service accounts initially — one for SSO sync (read-only) and one for webhook-based provisioning. I’ll add names once procurement finalizes.

One quick question: will Redwood need any inbound firewall changes on our side for the provisioning callback? We try to avoid inbound rules, so if webhooks can be delivered via a public endpoint behind mTLS, we prefer that.

Subject: OpenRidge access controls — kickoff summary & agreed next steps

Hi Evan (and team) —

Thanks for the productive kickoff earlier today. Below is a concise summary of decisions, owners, and the target timeline we agreed on.

Decisions made:
- SAML: we will support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Evan supplied Okta metadata; SP entity assertion validated during the call.
- SCIM: core attributes to map: userName, emails.value, givenName, familyName, externalId, groups, title. We agreed to a minimal-first rollout (provision users + group membership only) and then expand attributes in week 2.
- Service accounts: naming convention agreed as svc-redwood-<env>-<team> (e.g., svc-redwood-prod-platform). Two accounts to provision initially: svc-redwood-prod-sync and svc-redwood-prod-provision. Access will be least-privilege; Neha to define the exact roles.
- IP allowlist: OpenRidge provided NATed egress ranges. We will limit the allowlist to Redwood control-plane endpoints for the initial rollout to avoid user-facing outages. If you want tenant-level enforcement later, we’ll schedule a maintenance window.

Action items & owners (short):
- Evan / OpenRidge: upload filled openridge-sso-mapping.xlsx with two sample users and confirm final service account names (due: Tue 6/15).
- Monica (SE): run SAML SP test and initial SCIM push to staging (due: Wed 6/16).
- Neha (Identity): produce org-policy audit checklist and service-account role matrix (due: Wed 6/16).
- Marissa (CS): create the runbook and shared Drive folder; add procurement contacts for service account approval (due: Mon 6/14).

Attachments referenced: openridge-sso-mapping.xlsx (Jordan’s mapping stub), scim-attributes.csv (OpenRidge export), openridge-ip-allowlist.txt (OpenRidge NAT ranges).

Next sync: 6/16 at 10:00 AM PT — short status check and remediation steps if provisioning fails. If anything urgent comes up before then, please flag in this thread or DM me.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
